subject.title: gateway tool not available to external-provider agent sessions

question: Should explicitly allowlisted `gateway` remain available to owner-authorized external-provider agent sessions such as xAI/Grok, and what proof is required before changing that path?
rationale: The issue sits at the boundary between a reported provider-specific tool omission and a high-power gateway control tool, so maintainer intent is needed before broadening or preserving exposure behavior.

options.title: Prove and preserve explicit owner allow
options.body: Require focused xAI/Grok proof that explicit `alsoAllow` works for owner-authorized sessions, then repair only the provider/runtime filtering path if it fails.

options.title: Keep external-provider sessions excluded
options.body: Document that `gateway` is intentionally unavailable on that session class and point users to the supported owner/admin control surface.

options.title: Defer until live repro
options.body: Keep the issue open with no code change until a maintainer or reporter supplies current-main live evidence for the exact missing inventory.

recommendation.title: Prove and preserve explicit owner allow
recommendation.body: Require focused xAI/Grok proof that explicit `alsoAllow` works for owner-authorized sessions, then repair only the provider/runtime filtering path if it fails.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about the gateway control/security boundary and explicit allow policy, where the history points most strongly to Peter's prior work.
